meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: 收到产品链接、粘贴的文稿或简报后，它会按步骤制作一支发布/宣传视频：有网址就抓取该站作素材，再定视觉风格、编排分镜与旁白，最后渲染成视频。若输入是 Figma 网址，会先专门处理。
howto.when: 当你想宣传、发布或展示一个产品，或给出商业网址时触发；网站导览类需求同样适用。若意图不清，任务会转给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把我们的产品官网做成一分钟发布视频
say.note: 它会先抓取该网站作素材。

say.text: 根据我粘贴的产品文稿生成一支推广视频
say.note: 它会先保存文稿，用于规划分镜和旁白。

say.text: 给我们 App 的新功能介绍做一支演示视频
say.note: 它会先写分镜与旁白，最后渲染成片。

howto.what_en: Given a product link, pasted script, or brief, it makes a launch/promo video: captures the site when a URL is present, sets visual style, plans storyboard and voice-over, then renders the video. A Figma URL is handled first.
howto.when_en: Used when you want to promote, launch, or showcase a product, or provide a commercial URL; website tour/showcase requests also apply. If unclear, the task goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Make a one-minute launch video from our product website.
say_en.note: It captures the site as source assets first.

say_en.text: Create a promo video from the product text I've pasted.
say_en.note: It saves the text, then plans storyboard and voice-over.

say_en.text: Make a demo video introducing our app's new features.
say_en.note: It writes storyboard and voice-over, then renders.
